quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Precursor localisation (company): Jiangsu Xianke's H1 2026 revenue and operating profit rose sharply year on year - revenue RMB 74,746.57 ten-thousand (+34.69%) and net profit RMB 7,678.48 ten-thousand (+351.03%), on higher semiconductor chemical sales. Its processes cover synthesis, distillation and purification; it now has full in-house capability for high-k precursor organic ligands and exports crude precursors to the Korean subsidiary, which the company says lowers the overall cost of precursors and keeps the domestic precursor supply chain stable. The Korean semiconductor-chemicals holding company (Korea Xianke) had H1 revenue of RMB 86,248.13 ten-thousand and net profit of RMB 17,838.16 ten-thousand (+8.74%), helped by product mix and FX gains.
quarterly_data.figure: Jiangsu Xianke H1 revenue RMB 74,746.57 ten-thousand (+34.69%); net profit +351.03%

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Korean precursor capacity (company): to meet overseas fabs' growing and upgrading demand for precursor materials, its Korean subsidiary UP CHEM built a third plant, expected to be in full production by the end of 2026, and in H1 2026 bought new land and began planning a fourth plant. The UP plant renovation and expansion project (budget RMB 35,000,000.00) was 99% complete at mid-2026.
quarterly_data.figure: third plant in full production expected by end of 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LDS and wet chemicals (company): its semiconductor material delivery systems (LDS) achieved volume introduction at mainstream domestic wafer fabs; it is localising key components and developing a solid-source delivery system (SDS) for advanced processes. Its wet electronic chemicals (developers, thinners, strippers for semiconductor and display photoresists, made in Nantong and Guangzhou) have entered the supply chains of several mainstream domestic wafer fabs and panel makers, and production and sales of the photoresist-reagent line rose sharply year on year.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Packaging fillers and specialty gas (company): Yoke Xianke (Chengdu)'s spherical electronic powder lines are in full production; subsidiary Huafei Electronics had H1 2026 revenue of RMB 1.86 hundred million, up 50%, and net profit of RMB 1,116 ten-thousand, up more than 800%; its sub-micron spherical silica and spherical alumina now supply downstream customers stably, and it is expanding overseas sales of fillers for M8/M9-grade high-speed copper-clad laminates with positive progress. The Inner Mongolia Kemeite project (12000 tonnes of sulfur hexafluoride and 3000 tonnes of carbon tetrafluoride electronic specialty gas capacity) is expected to start production in Q3 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Huafei H1 revenue RMB 1.86 hundred million (+50%)
